## Prompt (English)

```text
Build Lantern Rise, an original one-screen portrait (9:16, fixed 540x960 logical canvas scaled to fit) 2D arcade game in a single self-contained HTML file with no external assets: a glowing paper lantern block slides left-right at 180 px/s along a silk cord at the top of the screen, the player taps/clicks/presses space to release it, and it falls onto a tiled rooftop to build the tallest stable tower possible.
```
